title: Design per-job landing from current main to remove the landing wait
summary: Write a design note under docs/design/ for throughput review 20261109-014617-5cg0: stop stacking landings on one local branch; build each job's single commit on fetched main via three-way merge and open one PR. The audience is Athena's maintainers and the next throughput review, which scores the prediction.
